chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: حَمْدَوَيْه، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْأَقَطِ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Sulayman ibn Khalid al-Aqta who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يَقُولُ: مَا أَحَدٌ أَحْيَا ذِكْرَنَا وَ أَحَادِيثَ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ إِلَّا زُرَارَةَ وَ أَبَا بَصِيرٍ لَيْثًا الْمُرَادِيَّ وَ مُحَمَّدَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ وَ بَرِيدَ بْنَ مُعَاوِيَةَ الْعَجَلِيَّ وَ لَوْ لَا هَؤُلَاءِ مَا كَانَ أَحَدٌ يَسْتَنْبِطُ هَذَا، هَؤُلَاءِ حُفَّاظُ الدِّينِ وَ أُمَنَاءُ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَلَى حَلَالِ اللَّهِ وَ حَرَامِهِ، وَ هُمُ السَّابِقُونَ إِلَيْنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَ السَّابِقُونَ إِلَيْنَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ

translations.en: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: No one has enlivened our remembrance and the narrations of my father (peace be upon him) except Zurara, Abu Basir Layth al-Muradi, Muhammad ibn Muslim, and Burayd ibn Mu'awiya al-Ijli. And if it were not for these four, there would be no one who could derive [the rulings]. These are the protectors of the religion and the trustees of my father (peace be upon him) regarding the Halal of Allah and His Haram. And they are the foremost to us in this world and the foremost to us in the hereafter.

en.summary: This hadith from Al-Kashi’s *Rijal* highlights the foundational role of the 'Four Companions' (Al-As-hab Al-Arba'a) in preserving the Imami tradition, specifically emphasizing their unique capacity to derive legal rulings (istinbat) from the Imam. By designating them as 'trustees of God’s halal and haram,' the Imam establishes their authority as the primary link between the divine source and the community, ensuring the continuity of religious knowledge. Their precedence in both worlds underscores the Shia belief that faithful transmission of hadith is a spiritual merit equal to worldly deeds.
en.seo_question: Who are the four main companions that preserved the narrations of Imam al-Sadiq?
